source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the types of immunity (PDF 175-176).

blocks.text: Ghair makhsoos difa (pehli aur doosri lines) paidaish se maujood hai, is liye ise paidaishi ya innate immunity kehte hain. Makhsoos difa barhte hue hasil hota aur acquired immunity kehlata hai. Acquired immunity ki do qismein hain.

items: Active immunity: jism khud jaraseem ke antigens ke khilaf antibodies banata hai.
Passive immunity: shakhs ko khaas jaraseem se larne ke liye antibodies di jati hain; passive immunity kam muddat ki hoti hai.

blocks.text: Active immunity qudrati ya masnooi ho sakti hai. Qudrati active immunity mein jism antigens ke saamne aa kar qudrati taur par antibodies banata hai; yeh immunity ki sab se mo'assar shakal hai. Masnooi active immunity kamzor antigens de kar (vaccination) hasil hoti hai jo jism ko asal antigens ke khilaf antibodies banane par uksate hain.

blocks.alt: Darakht numa khaaka. Immunity: Innate (ghair makhsoos; pehli aur doosri line) aur Acquired (makhsoos; teesri line). Acquired: Active (jism khud antibodies banata) aur Passive (shakhs ko antibodies di jati). Active: Natural Active (jism qudrati taur par antibodies banata) aur Artificial Active (vaccination se; jism ko antibodies banane par uksata).
blocks.caption: Figure 21.10: Immunity ki qismein aur un ke tareeqe (kitab ki Figure 21.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Aik bachcha khasre se theek hota hai; doosre ko khasre ki vaccine milti hai. Har aik ko kaun si immunity milti hai?
blocks.explanation: Pehle ko qudrati active immunity; doosre ko masnooi active immunity. Dono mein jism apni antibodies khud banata hai.

items: Acquired: active (apni antibodies) ya passive (di gayi antibodies, kam muddat).
